Core behavioural responsibilities for all employees
 
Agility We Lead with Agility  Integrity We Act with IntegrityExcellence We Empower ExcellenceCareWe Value Care


Job Description

Are you an experienced construction project leader with the commercial acumen to deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing the expectations of lenders, investors and key stakeholders?

We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Project Manager to fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role across Elgin’s utility-scale solar PV, BESS and co-located PV/BESS projects. The role is focused on leading multidisciplinary project teams within a single Elgin delivery framework, ensuring that finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations, route-to-market and external adviser inputs are coordinated into one clear project position from late stage development / FID through construction, commissioning, commercial operations and handover to Asset Management. Particular emphasis will be placed on lender, investor, SPV governance and internal delivery interfaces.
 
This role requires significant project and contract management experience, including direct involvement in project finance processes, lender due diligence, conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender reporting, waivers / consents and coordination with lender technical advisers. The successful candidate will need specific experience with FIDIC based Construction Contracts, strong commercial judgement, disciplined contract administration capability and the ability to translate project delivery status into clear funding, governance and decision-making outputs.
 
To be successful in the role, you will have experience representing a client, employer, sponsor or SPV in the delivery of complex infrastructure or renewable energy projects. You will be commercially astute, highly organised, confident leading multidisciplinary project teams through a common governance and delivery framework, and capable of engaging credibly with lenders, investors, advisers, contractors, shareholder forums and senior internal stakeholders.

What you will be do:

  • Fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role for allocated projects, ensuring Elgin’s SPV, governance, commercial and contractual obligations are actively managed from FID through COD and handover.
  • Lead project and contract management on project-financed assets, coordinating lender processes including conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender technical adviser queries, lender reporting, waivers / consents and funding milestone submissions.
  • Administer and manage high-value EPC, ICP and related project contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment applications, completion milestones, liquidated damages, defects and close-out obligations.
  • Maintain disciplined project controls across programme, budget, cash flow, risk, actions, decisions and change, ensuring transparent reporting to senior management, SPV governance bodies, lenders and investors.
  • Act as the primary project coordination point between Elgin’s internal project team, finance, legal, procurement, engineering, construction, operations, route-to-market and external advisers, ensuring that all workstreams operate from one integrated delivery plan, one risk position and one set of decision requirements.
  • Lead and manage multidisciplinary internal project teams within Elgin’s agreed delivery framework by setting priorities, clarifying accountabilities, managing dependencies, aligning workstreams to project milestones and escalating decisions in a timely and structured manner.
  • Manage the relationship and reporting cadence with project finance lenders, equity investors, shareholder representatives, lender technical advisers and other key finance-facing stakeholders, including preparing and presenting clear, decision-ready updates for shareholder forums and related governance meetings.
  • Oversee contractor, owner’s engineer and technical adviser interfaces to ensure delivery evidence, technical outputs and contractual positions support Elgin’s funding, governance and employer obligations.
  • Proactively identify commercial, contractual, programme and financing risks, develop mitigation plans and ensure issues are escalated with clear options, recommendations and decision requirements.
  • Support tendering, contract negotiation and commercial strategy by ensuring delivery arrangements are bankable, financeable, contractually robust and aligned with lender / investor expectations.


Your profile

What you will need: 

  • Degree in project management, construction management, engineering, or similar.
  • Extensive experience in infrastructure, renewables, power, energy storage or comparable capital projects, with significant project and contract management responsibility.
  • Direct experience working on project-financed projects, including lender due diligence, , funding drawdowns, lender technical adviser processes and ongoing lender / investor reporting.
  • Strong understanding of the Client / Employer’s Representative role and experience representing an owner, SPV, sponsor or employer in the delivery of complex contracted projects.
  • Extensive experience administering FIDIC, EPC, ICP and construction management contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment mechanisms, completion tests, liquidated damages and contractual close-out.
  • Demonstrable ability to lead multidisciplinary internal teams and align finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations and external adviser inputs around delivery milestones within a standardised delivery framework.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to assess risk versus reward, protect the employer’s position and communicate implications clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience preparing and presenting concise, decision-ready reports for senior management, investment committees, SPV boards, lenders, investors, shareholder forums and other governance forums, with the ability to translate complex programme, commercial, technical and financing issues into clear options and recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of utility-scale solar PV, BESS, grid connection and route-to-market interfaces, with sufficient technical understanding to challenge contractors and advisers effectively.
  • Highly organised and proficient in Microsoft Office and project controls tools, with strong written communication, meeting management and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Valid driver’s license for Ireland and the UK.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!</p></div><p style="line-height: 1.2;"><strong>Your opportunity<br></strong></p> <p>Elevate your career here at New Relic, where you'll make a significant impact as the Senior Revenue Operations Manager for our critical Strategic and Enterprise segments in EMEA. You will serve as a strategic business partner to both the Senior Director of Strategic Sales and the VP of Enterprise Sales, ensuring operational rigor, optimizing the rhythm of business, and enhancing sales productivity across a go-to-market team of around eighty strong spanning Europe, Middle East and Africa.</p> <p>This opportunity is perfect for those who possess natural leadership qualities and have the apt to deliver with minimal steer. You have the strength to excel in navigating complex sales environments and extracting high-level strategic insights. Collaboration, critical thinking, and a growth mindset will be essential as you architect tools, reporting, and governance to support scalable growth in the Strategic Enterprise space. Your curiosity and innovative approach will help provide sophisticated analyses and recommendations, contributing to the accelerated growth of our largest customers.</p> <p>This hybrid role offers flexibility, with an expectation to work from our local office 1-2 days a week as required, balancing teamwork and independence.</p> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><strong>What you'll do<br></strong></p> <p><strong>Strategic Business Partnering &amp; Forecast Rigour:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive the weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasting cadence specifically for the Strategic and Enterprise business units; ensure accuracy in predicting closure of complex, high-value deals.</li> <li>Partner with Sales Leadership to conduct deep-dive pipeline analysis, identifying risks in opportunities, advising on deal health and providing cross-functional counsel.</li> <li>Apply advanced statistical rigor to the weekly and quarterly forecasting cadence, moving beyond intuition to provide data-backed predictions for high-value Enterprise deals.</li> <li>Conduct deep-dive analyses on forecast-to-actual variances to identify systemic risks and improve the overall predictability of the book of business.</li> <li>Lead the preparation and execution of Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for the sectors, presenting actionable insights to executive leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Enterprise Deal Strategy &amp; Operational Excellence:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted advisor on large deal structures, collaborating with Legal, Finance, and Deal Desk to streamline non-standard approvals and complex contracting processes.</li> <li>Analyze whitespace and penetration within Strategic &amp; Enterprise accounts to support Account Executives in maximizing revenue potential.</li> <li>Ensure effective governance and compliance within the Enterprise deal cycle while maintaining sales velocity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data, Systems, and Advanced Analytics:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Standardize and optimize CRM processes specifically for Enterprise selling motions (e.g., multi-stakeholder mapping, complex buying centers).</li> <li>Provide ad-hoc, high-level reporting for insights and recommendations on trends, consumption, churn risk, and expansion opportunities.</li> <li>Track and communicate key performance indicators, as well as critical leading indicators, ensuring their mathematical integrity.</li> <li>Architect and maintain complex financial and operational models that track consumption trends, churn risk, and expansion opportunities across the EMEA region.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Sales Enablement &amp; Process Architecture:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive and influence process improvements to systems and workflows to suit the specific needs of long-cycle Enterprise sales.</li> <li>Propose enhancements for better user experiences and efficiency for Sales Executives and Account Managers.</li> <li>Support initiatives for application enhancement and process automation to reduce administrative burden on high-performing sales teams.</li> <li>Collaborate with Enablement teams to ensure the field is proficient across the sales process, playbooks and tools required to excel in their roles.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fiscal Year Planning &amp; Territory Design:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the coordination of sales plans and segmentation for the Strategic &amp; Enterprise business, designing equitable territories and quotas.</li> <li>Advise on international commission splits and rules relevant to multi-regional Strategic accounts.</li> <li>Maintain mid-year cycles to ensure optimal coverage across the segments and territories.</li> </ul> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><strong>This role requires<br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Extensive Operations Experience:</strong> Deep background in sales or revenue operations, specifically supporting Enterprise or Strategic customer segments in the technology sector.</li> <li><strong>Scale &amp; Complexity:</strong> Proven experience managing a complex book of business in excess of <strong>$200M+</strong> in revenue.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Data Storytelling:</strong> Advanced numerical literacy with the proven ability to influence Executive Sales Leaders (Strategic Account Directors and VPs) by translating complex data sets into a clear strategic narrative.</li> <li><strong>Quantitative &amp; Statistical Rigor:</strong> Demonstrated expertise in applying <strong>advanced statistical models</strong> to forecasting cadence, moving beyond intuition to provide data-backed predictive accuracy for high-value Enterprise deals.</li> <li><strong>Analytical Execution &amp; Integrity:</strong> A meticulous approach to maintaining the mathematical integrity of KPIs and architecting complex financial/operational models that track consumption trends and churn.</li> <li><strong>SaaS &amp; Consumption Acumen:</strong> Deep familiarity with Consumption and SaaS go-to-market models, particularly "LAER" strategies, and the mathematical drivers behind them (e.g., NRR, CAC, and LTV).</li> <li><strong>Strategic Fiscal Planning:</strong> Hands-on experience in the mathematical architecture of territory design, equitable quota setting, and complex international commission splits.</li> <li><strong>Technical Proficiency:</strong> High proficiency in leading GTM Tech Stack tooling, including Salesforce and Tableau, with the ability to navigate the full lead-to-cash journey.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Influence:</strong> Demonstrated skill in complex analysis and influencing cross-functional teams such as Finance, Legal, and Deal Desk to streamline high-stakes account management.</li> </ul> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><strong>Bonus points if you have<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Hold a professional certification such as a CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst), CPA, or a degree in a quantitative field (Economics, Statistics, Finance, or Engineering).</li> <li>Proficiency of financial modeling, including the ability to build automated, dynamic models with complex logic (VBA, Macros, or advanced Google Apps Script).</li> <li>Experience with advanced Revenue Operations frameworks (e.g., Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, or Tableau Desktop Specialist).</li> <li>Direct experience in a high-growth, consumption-driven or usage-based business model (e.g., Snowflake, Datadog, AWS).</li> <li>Deep understanding of the Observability or Monitoring landscape and the specific commercial metrics that drive the sector.</li> <li>Prior experience in formal people management or as a project lead for global GTM transformation initiatives.</li> <li>Proficiency in a second European language, specifically German, French, or Spanish, to support the wider EMEA region.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-JJ2</p> <p style="line-height: 1.2;">&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.&nbsp;</p> <p>If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to <a ----- ----- <p>We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid.</p> <p><strong>Our hiring process</strong><br><br>In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.<br><br>We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the&nbsp;<a href="https://sfgov.org/olse/sites/default/files/FCO%20poster2020.pdf" target="_blank">San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance</a>.<br><br>Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.</p> <p>New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U.S. export controls and licensing requirements. Certain New Relic roles require candidates to pass an export compliance assessment as a condition of employment in any global location. If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process.</p> <p>Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics.&nbsp;</p> <p>Review our Applicant Privacy Notice at&nbsp;<a href="https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/applicant-privacy-policy" target="_blank">https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/applicant-privacy-policy</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><em>At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _ect4ttxp _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="http://klaviyo.com/careers" data-renderer-mark="true">klaviyo.com/careers</a>&nbsp;to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.</em></p></div><h1>About the Role</h1> <p>Klaviyo is looking for a <strong>Lead Principal of APAC Partner Enablement</strong> to lead the strategy and execution of partner enablement across the Asia-Pacific region, with an initial focus on Australia &amp; New Zealand, Southeast Asia, and broader emerging markets in the region.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This role is critical to scaling our APAC partner ecosystem and accelerating regional growth, with partners serving as the <strong>tip of the spear</strong> for selling, implementing, and driving adoption of Klaviyo’s <strong>Autonomous CRM platform</strong> across a diverse set of markets, business models, and levels of digital maturity.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>You will own the <strong>APAC partner enablement strategy</strong>, evolving and scaling existing programs to drive deeper partner capability, stronger pipeline impact, and broader platform adoption across marketing, service, and analytics—underpinned by AI. A core part of this role is helping partners evolve their offerings and Klaviyo skills to align with the future of Klaviyo’s Autonomous CRM, adapted for regional nuances (channels, languages, verticals, and go‑to‑market motions).</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Based in&nbsp;<strong>Sydney</strong>, this role sits on the <strong>Global Partnerships</strong> team and works closely with APAC regional and cross-functional leaders to deliver high-impact enablement that prepares partners not just for today’s platform—but for where Klaviyo is going next.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a <strong>player-coach</strong> role: you will operate hands-on in the field, contributing to content creation while also setting strategy, influencing roadmap priorities, and mentoring a growing APAC enablement team.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>What You’ll Do</h1> <h2>APAC Partner Enablement Strategy &amp; Execution</h2> <ul> <li>Define and execute Klaviyo’s <strong>APAC partner enablement strategy</strong>, aligned to top company priorities, regional growth goals, and in‑market realities (e.g., ANZ maturity vs. emerging markets in Southeast Asia).</li> <li>Ensure APAC enablement supports the <strong>full partner lifecycle</strong>—from selling/co‑selling and implementation to expansion and long-term customer growth—tailored to agency, consultancy, and SI partner motions in the region.</li> <li>Build and maintain a regional partner enablement framework that can be localized by <strong>country, language, and vertical</strong> (e.g., ecommerce, hospitality, financial services) while staying consistent with global standards.</li> </ul> <h2>Regional Growth &amp; Expansion</h2> <ul> <li>Support continued impact and optimization of partnerships in <strong>Australia &amp; New Zealand</strong>, while driving scalable playbooks the rest of APAC can inherit and adapt.</li> <li>Partner closely with regional leadership to accelerate expansion into <strong>priority APAC markets</strong> (e.g., Southeast Asia, Japan, Korea, India), using partners as a primary growth lever.</li> <li>Serve as a senior representative of Klaviyo in the field, delivering <strong>regionalized enablement</strong> through live 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many trainings, workshops, and localized content—both virtually and in‑person across the region.</li> <li>Help define and refine the <strong>ideal APAC partner profile</strong> and partner value propositions, working closely with regional Partner Sales and Partner Marketing.</li> </ul> <h2>Platform Enablement</h2> <ul> <li>Enable APAC partners to confidently <strong>position, sell, and execute</strong> across Klaviyo’s Autonomous CRM platform, spanning marketing, service, and analytics, including country-specific channels (e.g., SMS, messaging apps) and compliance considerations.</li> <li>Contribute to <strong>enablement content creation</strong> and flagship initiatives for new platform capabilities, ensuring global assets are adapted for APAC use cases, examples, and customer stories—not just translated.</li> <li>Act as a <strong>product-obsessed</strong> leader who stays fluent across platform capabilities and can translate new features into clear, practical partner plays for APAC markets.</li> </ul> <h2>Cross-Functional Engagement</h2> <ul> <li>Work closely with <strong>Product Marketing, Internal Enablement, Partner Marketing, and Partner Sales</strong> to execute the APAC enablement strategy, ensuring regional needs are clearly represented in global planning and content.</li> <li>Influence enablement strategy, tooling, and roadmap priorities so that APAC partners can access the right content, in the right format and language, at the right time.</li> <li>Collaborate with <strong>Customer Success, Sales, and Solutions</strong> teams in APAC to close the loop between partner enablement, field feedback, and customer outcomes.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>APJ Enablement Vision &amp; Strategic Leadership</strong><br><br></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Orchestrate a unified APJ enablement strategy</strong> that prioritizes partner health maturity and establishes clear, scalable development paths aligned with regional growth objectives.</li> <li><strong>Execute as a strategic player-coach</strong>, optimizing cross-functional performance across presales and channel teams while driving hands-on resell activation for high-impact markets and partners.</li> <li><strong>Champion an agile culture of experimentation</strong>, leveraging data-driven feedback loops to transform the APJ enablement function into a primary engine for partner self-sufficiency and accelerated revenue readiness.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Measurement &amp; Impact</h2> <p>Drive measurable outcomes including:</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Increased <strong>partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline</strong> in APAC, with clear attribution back to enablement programs.</li> <li>Increased <strong>platform adoption and depth of usage</strong> through partners across priority products and key APAC verticals.</li> <li>Growth in <strong>certified APAC partners</strong> and trained practitioners, with clear regional certification and accreditation paths.</li> <li>Improved <strong>time-to-first-value</strong> and <strong>time-to-scaled-value</strong> for customers onboarded via partners in the region.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>What We’re Looking For</h1> <h2>Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Proven experience leading <strong>partner enablement, Partner Success, or Education</strong> in a SaaS environment, ideally within CRM, MarTech, or platform-based ecosystems.</li> <li>Strong background working with <strong>international partner ecosystems</strong>, with significant hands-on experience in APAC (and ideally some familiarity with EMEA or other international regions).</li> <li>Experience supporting a wide range of partner types, including <strong>digital agencies, consultancies, and system integrators</strong>, ideally across multiple APAC countries and levels of maturity.</li> <li>Demonstrated success building or scaling partner enablement programs in <strong>high-growth, rapidly evolving</strong> environments.</li> </ul> <h2>Skills &amp; Capabilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Exceptional storytelling and presentation skills</strong>, with the ability to inspire and enable partners in live, field-based settings across diverse cultures and markets.</li> <li>Deep <strong>product curiosity and fluency</strong>, with the ability to translate complex product capabilities into simple, outcome-oriented partner plays for APAC customers.</li> <li>Strong <strong>cross-functional operator</strong> who can influence without direct authority and align global and regional teams behind APAC enablement priorities.</li> <li>A <strong>bias towards action</strong>, with an extreme ownership mentality and growth mindset—comfortable testing, iterating, and scaling what works.</li> <li>An <strong>AI-first mindset</strong>, using AI to increase speed, scale, and impact of enablement efforts, and to help APAC partners work smarter across content creation, analysis, and execution.</li> </ul> <h2>Leadership</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Player-coach</strong> mentality with experience managing and developing talent; able to stay close to the work while zooming out to set direction.</li> <li><strong>Strategic thinker</strong> who is equally comfortable executing tactically—willing to roll up their sleeves in market while shaping long-term APAC enablement strategy.</li> <li>Able to operate effectively in a <strong>fast-paced, high-growth</strong> environment, navigating ambiguity and changing priorities while keeping partners and internal teams aligned.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Klaviyo in APAC:</strong></h2> <p>We are starting small but have big plans for Klaviyo in APAC. Our Sydney team began to take shape throughout 2022 and has now built out our go to market teams in sales, customer success, partnerships, marketing, recruiting and product support. As the team grows we will see a continued expansion of Klaviyo’s customer base and the building of a fantastic working culture in line with what we see elsewhere in Klaviyo but with its own local identity within our Sydney based team. This is your unique opportunity to join us at an very early stage and help to shape our future Klaviyo in APAC.</p> <p>One of our values as a company is ‘always learning’ and you can feel that in APAC. People are looking to grow and develop and Klaviyo provides a great platform to do so. As we are still relatively early in our journey in APAC this means there is a lot of headroom to grow and develop within your role - we are looking for the leaders of the future. At Klaviyo generally managers are often promoted up into their roles and people are regularly being promoted or moving into new functional areas - it really is an education through experience here.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We use Covey as part of our hiring and / or promotional process. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.</p> <p>The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery.&nbsp;</p> <p>Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.</p> <p>The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>About Iso</strong></h3> <p>Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.</p> <p>Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.</p> <p>We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.</p> <p>Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h3><strong>Your impact&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>As a <strong>Security Engineer (Corporate Security)</strong>&nbsp;you will play a pivotal role in creating and maintaining a resilient, user-friendly and scalable corporate security environment at Isomorphic Labs. Operating with a proactive, service-minded approach and a strong bias for AI and automation, you will safeguard our workforce, identity systems, and sensitive data.</p> <p>In this unique and polyvalent role, you will implement and maintain pragmatic corporate security controls across a wide range of domains such as IAM, DLP, corporate/external applications, and data governance. You will participate in detection and incident response and develop long-lasting measures to improve our corporate security posture. Beyond technical controls, you will also build scalable and secure operational processes across a wide range of domains such as data transfer or systems integration that will materially impact IsoLabs’ mission. You will directly support AI/medical researchers on security topics and will ensure our cross-functional teams can innovate rapidly, securely, and with total confidence.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Corporate Identity &amp; Access Management (IAM):</strong> Design, optimize, and support corporate IAM structures, including group architectures, identity system integration, and streamlined employee onboarding/offboarding workflows.</li> <li><strong>Corporate Security Controls:</strong> Audit corporate systems security and deploy/maintain a wide range of security tools (e.g., logging, monitoring &amp; DLP, data labeling, AI agents).</li> <li><strong>Data Governance: </strong>Collaborating with Corp Engineering,<strong> </strong>enhance data governance and security within corporate systems (Google Workspace, Confluence, Jira, Slack, etc.) by gathering user needs and co-developing scalable operating models, appropriate configurations, and SOPs.</li> <li><strong>Incident Response &amp; Alert Triage: </strong>Partner closely with Detection &amp; Response security engineers to improve and triage corporate security alerts, support incident response efforts when issues arise and address Google’ vulnerabilities and bugs.</li> <li><strong>Security Awareness:</strong> Promote corporate security rules, support security awareness training and run social engineering exercises.</li> <li><strong>Workplace Security: </strong>Collaborate with Workplace and Tech teams to ensure the security of physical systems (badges, lab workstations) and offices.</li> <li><strong>Security of Operations &amp; Processes: </strong>Translate key user needs and security compliance requirements into clear operational processes—such as establishing workflows for onboarding new tools, setting up data transfers and external system integrations.</li> <li><strong>Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM):</strong> Execute standardized vendor and software audits, improve SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) through tools, and address third-party integrations and supply-chain safety risks.</li> <li><strong>Automation &amp; AI Integration:</strong> Leverage AI tools and agentic workflows to automate routine security tasks, optimize triage, and streamline operations.</li> <li><strong>User Enablement:</strong> Act as a positive, proactive point of contact for internal teams, delivering user-oriented security solutions that reduce friction while upholding high security standards.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Skills and qualifications&nbsp;</strong></h3> <h3><strong>Essential:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Fluency in navigating complex multi-org corporate systems’ workflows and processes.</li> <li>Experience with Atlassian’s and/or Google’s tech stacks.</li> <li>Proficiency in collecting user needs and business requirements, turning high-level guidance into efficient SOPs, policies, and guidelines documents.</li> <li>Strong foundation in Corporate Systems Security and IAM, including hands-on experience with SSO, user lifecycle management, and directory/group structures.</li> <li>Proficiency in basic Python, Go, or PowerShell to interface with REST APIs across SaaS ecosystems (Slack, Google Workspace, Okta).</li> <li>Knowledge of SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), and ideally, experience using tools like AppOmni, Adaptive Shield, or native SaaS log analysis to spot misconfigurations.</li> <li>Experience implementing Data Loss Prevention (DLP) corporate controls, data classification/labeling, and corporate data governance frameworks.</li> <li>Practical experience establishing or executing standardized vendor technical security assessments.</li> <li>Background in supporting security incident response and handling daily security alert triage.</li> <li>A strong bias for automation and an eagerness to leverage AI tools or agentic scanning mechanisms within corporate security workflows.</li> <li>Proactive, positive, and highly user-oriented mindset with exceptional communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to have:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience in high-growth tech environments, BioTech, ML-centric companies, or the pharmaceutical industry.</li> <li>Familiarity with OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, prompt injection prevention, and secure integration of internal AI assistants.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building or integrating AI-driven automation, agentic workflows, or custom scripts for security operations.</li> <li>Understanding of security patterns for Electronic Lab Notebooks (ELNs), Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), or High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with GitHub Enterprise security settings, secret scanning, and developer environment hardening.</li> <li>Familiarity with common data protection regulations and security frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001).</li> <li>Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Security+, CISSP, CISA, GSEC).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><br>Culture and values</strong></h3> <p>We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Thoughtful<br></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day.</span></p> <p><strong>Brave<br></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less.</span></p> <p><strong>Determined<br></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.</span></p> <p><strong>Together<br></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.</span></p> <h3><strong><br>Creating an extraordinary company</strong></h3> <p>We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. We're building an environment where collaboration is fundamental, learning is shared and every employee feels supported and able to thrive. We value unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, and perspectives, and harness these qualities to create extraordinary impact.</p> <p>We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.</p> <h3><strong><br>Hybrid working</strong></h3> <p>It’s hugely important for us to share knowledge and build strong relationships with each other, and we find it easier to do this if we spend time together in person. This is why we follow a hybrid model, and <strong>would require you to be able to come into the office 3 days a week</strong> (currently Tuesday, Wednesday, and one other day depending on which team you’re in). If you have additional needs that would prevent you from following this hybrid approach, we’d be happy to talk through these if you’re selected for an initial screening call.</p> <p><strong>Please note that when you submit an application, your data will be processed in line with our <a href="https://www.isomorphiclabs.com/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy" target="_blank">privacy policy</a>.</strong></p> <p><br>&gt;&gt; <a href="https://www.isomorphiclabs.com/work-with-us#current-job-openings">Click to view other open roles at Isomorphic Labs</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><div><strong>About Us</strong></div> <div> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.&nbsp;</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> </div></div><p><strong>Available Location:&nbsp;</strong>London, UK</p> <p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner – GTM to join our London-based EMEA team. Acting as a strategic talent advisor and go-to-market specialist, you will drive the expansion of our sales and GTM teams with full autonomy. You will leverage your deep market expertise, extensive network, and AI-driven strategies to identify and secure top-tier talent for Cloudflare. While your primary focus will be the SEUR region, using your recruitment experience in France, Spain, Italy and Portugal to navigate these specific markets, you will also maintain the agility to pivot your support to other regions as business needs evolve.</p> <p><strong><em>Language Requirements: </em></strong><em>Fluency in French is required to effectively partner with regional stakeholders and candidates; proficiency in Spanish is considered a significant advantage.</em></p> <p><strong>Core Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>End-to-End Recruitment &amp; Talent Strategy:</strong> Build and execute comprehensive talent strategies to help hiring leaders build high-performing teams, functioning similarly to how a salesperson puts together a go-to-market plan.</li> <li><strong>Proactive Pipeline &amp; Passive Candidate Outreach:</strong> Draw upon an extensive network of industry contacts to build proactive pipeline strategies for a variety of GTM roles, maintaining a heavy focus on Account Executives and Customer Engineers.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management &amp; Advising:</strong> Build and maintain solid relationships with the GEO VP and cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, HRBPs, and compensation teams.</li> <li><strong>AI-Agent Integration &amp; Analytics:</strong> Leverage foundational data layers and recruitment analytics to inform talent strategies, actively analysing metrics such as time-to-hire and source efficiency to drive optimal operational decisions.</li> <li><strong>Employer Branding &amp; Market Awareness:</strong> Lead and execute strategic employer branding initiatives tailored to the EMEA market to elevate Cloudflare's profile as a top destination for GTM talent.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Extensive GTM Recruiting Experience:</strong> A proven track record of success as a Senior Recruiter, well-versed in scaling technical and sales GTM organisations.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Problem Solving:</strong> Ability to operate two "plays" ahead, anticipating potential bottlenecks before they materialise, and resolving complex organisational issues with high autonomy.</li> <li><strong>Negotiation &amp; Closing Skills:</strong> Effective negotiation capabilities to secure top-tier candidates, driven by a deep understanding of Cloudflare’s unique value proposition.</li> <li><strong>AI &amp; Ecosystem Proficiency:</strong> Demonstrated capability to leverage automated workflows, AI-powered sourcing environments, and LLMs for complex boolean logic, market mapping, and productivity multiplication.</li> <li><strong>Candidate Experience Focus:</strong> Strong organisational skills to eliminate operational friction, ensuring clear communication and proactive engagement throughout the interview lifecycle.</li> <li><strong>Communication &amp; Influencing:</strong> Exceptional written and verbal English skills, with the ability to communicate transparently, foster alignment across teams and stakeholders and leverage data and market insights to influence.</li> <li><strong>Adaptability &amp; Self-Direction:</strong> Comfort thriving in ever-changing environments, taking complete responsibility for outcomes while seamlessly navigating an evolving technological and organisational landscape.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Group Chief Financial Officer (Relocation to Milan)
description: Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Milan office. About us Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn’t stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives. By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need. Joining our team means stepping into a critical role with the authority and responsibility to drive significant business outcomes and shape the strategic trajectory of the company and the industry. We are powered by a culture of ownership, relentless execution, and strategic foresight. We are brave in our approach, making courageous decisions and tackling challenges head-on, underpinned by a deep sense of responsibility for sustainable, ethical, and long-term success. What you'll be doing As Group CFO, you will serve as the primary financial strategist and a key partner to the CEO, shaping Satispay’s international financial roadmap from our Milan headquarters. Your mandate includes overseeing the Group’s financial strategy, capital allocation and consolidated finance activities, supporting the company’s growth and future capital markets objectives. You will lead and scale a best-in-class Group Finance organization, spanning FP&A, Financial Control, Group Reporting, Investor Relations, and Finance Business Partnering capabilities, while ensuring consistent financial governance and alignment across all entities, including our regulated financial activities in Luxembourg. In this role, your main responsibilities will be: Executive Financial Strategy: Act as a primary member of the Executive Team, influencing corporate development, monetization plans, and the overarching business model. Define and execute the Group’s long-term financial strategy, including capital allocation priorities, profitability frameworks, and value creation initiatives across business lines and geographies. Corporate Finance & Capital Management: Lead all corporate finance activities including equity fundraising, debt structuring, investor relations, M&A execution, financial due diligence, and valuation processes. Act as a key interface with the Board, shareholders, and institutional investors, supporting IPO preparation or capital markets readiness initiatives. Financial Reporting & Governance: Oversee Group financial reporting, including consolidated accounts, statutory reporting, and financial governance across all entities. Ensure consistency and integrity of financial data, supporting both internal decision-making and external reporting requirements. FP&A & Growth Performance: Lead Group FP&A, including budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis across all business units. Develop forward-looking financial models to support strategic decision-making, scenario planning, and resource allocation across the company. Group Finance Organization: Ensure strong alignment between strategic planning, operational execution, and financial performance management across all entities. Entity Governance: Oversee the Luxembourg banking subsidiary, ensuring effective financial governance and alignment with Group standards. Work closely with the Bank CFO and local leadership on regulatory reporting, treasury management, and financial control activities. What we're looking for We are seeking a proven leader with a distinguished track record of success in driving strategic initiatives and achieving significant business growth within relevant sectors. You will lead by example, combining ambition with purpose, drive impactful results and cultivate ownership and continuous improvement in our dynamic environment. Executive Experience: A minimum of 8 years in progressive financial leadership roles, including at least 3 years acting as a Group CFO, VP of Finance, or Deputy CFO within a premier technology scale-up, neo-bank, payments company, or fast-paced fintech environment. Capital Markets Expertise : A demonstrated history of engaging with institutional investors, steering Series funding initiatives, or managing transitions within IPO/SPAC frameworks. Regulatory Knowledge: Experience operating in or alongside regulated financial environments (banking, payments, fintech, or e-money institutions), with strong understanding of governance and compliance frameworks. For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team.

 

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK.

You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care.

 

What you will be doing:

  • Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment.

  • Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management.

  • Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices.

  • Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs).

 

What you need:

  • Full GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Pain

  • Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

 

Why join us?

  • Highly Competitive Salary: £190,000 - £275,000 FTE, pro rata for part time roles

Engineering in a test-learn-iterate fashion.</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: center;"><em>What you'll bring</em></p> <ul> <li>An extensive and varied track record building AI-native products and UX, including scaling access across multiple interaction surfaces such as UI, APIs, CLIs, and MCPs.</li> <li>Experience directly managing engineers, ideally in a client-facing or solutions-engineering capacity, and turning sophisticated clients' bespoke needs into scalable integrations.</li> <li>Fluency in modern Product/Engineering practice: Agile, continuous discovery and delivery, JTBD, vertical slicing, test-learn-iterate.</li> <li>Strong commercial acumen and data-informed decision-making, paired with a storyteller's flair and a relentless can-do attitude.</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build a business, create opportunities, and operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy.
